claim: The official NCT06372145 registry record names ToleDYNAMIC as a biomarker substudy in an active, nonrandomized, open-label phase 3 extension. It states that participants from the progressive-MS parent trials start open-label tolebrutinib, lists biomarker change from extension baseline through 12 months, reports no posted results, and estimates study completion in April 2029. The record permits qualified-researcher IPD requests through Vivli but does not establish that ongoing ToleDYNAMIC assay data are currently shareable.
future_grounding_route: Ask Sanofi whether the HERCULES Appendix 11 substudy and the NCT06372145 extension substudy are one continuous protocol or distinct sampling periods; request the extension protocol/SAP, rollover CONSORT by parent arm, actual prior exposure, selection timing, completed assay counts, and availability timeline. If former-placebo initiators and former-tolebrutinib continuers are both represented, permit only a selection-conditional initiation-versus-continuation trajectory sensitivity, never a current randomized drug-versus-placebo effect.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: Active-only design permits temporal pharmacodynamics but not randomized treatment-effect inference

project_use: Confirms the active-only causal boundary, explains why completed results or a mature package should not be assumed, and adds a bounded prior-randomization-anchored initiation-versus-continuation contrast if complete rollover metadata exist. It does not upgrade any module, mechanism, target, or treatment claim.
relationship_note: The registry converges with the HERCULES protocol's active-treatment wording but changes the practical request: seek ongoing-study collaboration and design documents first, and treat any available extension biomarker data as selected open-label follow-up.

source.citation: ClinicalTrials.gov. NCT06372145, LTS17043: phase 3 extension study of tolebrutinib; record last posted 13 February 2026.
source.label: Official ClinicalTrials.gov registry record and API v2 JSON

source_terms.reuse_notes: Only short factual metadata paraphrases are stored. No participant data, protocol attachment, or assay result is redistributed.
